heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly cloudy. Showers likely near and north of Route 2, a rising chance to the south; thunder possible. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s, some mid 60s northeast. South to southeast winds gusting 25 mph, except to 35 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy. Showers likely and maybe a thunderstorm, except diminishing by midnight in the St. Lawrence Valley. Lows in the low to mid 60s. South to southwest winds 5 to 10 mph and gusting to 20 mph, except gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Thursday
text: Chance of a sprinkle near the Vermont/Québec border, otherwise breezy with decreasing clouds. Highs in the mid to upper 70s south and in the Champlain and northern Connecticut valleys, low to mid 70s elsewhere north. West winds 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.
